# Kynthai — AI-Powered Family Health for the United States

Kynthai is a family-first AI health app built for US households. It combines medication adherence, drug-safety intelligence, doctor consults, and lab bookings — purpose-built for families where one person often manages health for 2–4 family members.

## What is Kynthai?
Kynthai is a health-management platform operated by Kynthai Health Technologies Inc., based in Wilmington, Delaware. It brings together medicine reminders, AI health tools, video consultations with verified US-licensed doctors, lab test bookings, and family health management — all in one trusted app designed for American families.

## Key Features
- Smart medicine reminders with snooze, streaks, and caretaker alerts
- AI Health Assistant (text-based Q&A about medicines, symptoms, and health)
- Video consultations with US-licensed verified doctors
- Lab test bookings with sample pickup (where available)
- Drug & food interaction checker (AI-powered)
- Family Care Hub (up to 4 members — parents, kids, elders in one dashboard)
- Pill identification via camera (vision AI)
- Prescription scanning & intelligence
- Health insights & weekly AI reports
- Emergency SOS alerts to family members (911 for emergencies)
- Natural language schedule parser ("take this pill after lunch")

## Target Users
- Families managing multi-generational care (caretakers for parents/elders)
- Individual patients with chronic conditions (diabetes, hypertension, thyroid)
- US-licensed doctors seeking patient management and e-consultation tools
- US diagnostic labs for home-sample booking

## Plans & Pricing (USD)
- Free: 1 member, up to 10 medications, 3 AI chats/day, all reminders — $0/month
- Plus: Unlimited medications, unlimited AI, priority consults — $9.99/month ($99.99/year)
- Family Pro: Up to 4 members, weekly AI insights, all features — $19.99/month ($199.99/year)
- Early Founding Members: Locked at $9.99/mo (Plus) and $19.99/mo (Family Pro) — forever pricing

## Competitive Differentiation
Unlike single-patient apps, Kynthai was built from day one for multi-member households. Your parents' medications and your kids' schedules live in the same dashboard with caretaker alerts. AI drug-interaction checking, prescription scanning via vision AI, and family health insights are features that no competitor currently offers at this depth in the US market.

## AI Safety & Compliance
All AI features provide advisory information only — not medical advice. AI outputs are clearly labelled, and a licensed doctor should always be consulted before making medical decisions. Kynthai is HIPAA-aligned: health data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Users can export or delete their data anytime. In a medical emergency, call 911.

## Technology
- Built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- AI powered by ZenMux (stepfun models) with fallback chain
- Payments: Stripe (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, ACH)
- SMS/Notifications: Twilio
- Database: Prisma ORM
- Caching: Upstash Redis
- Error tracking: Sentry
- HIPAA-aligned architecture (BAA with AI processor recommended)

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is Kynthai free to use?
A: Yes. The Free tier includes 1 member profile, up to 10 medications, 3 AI chats per day, all smart reminders, and drug interaction checks. No credit card required.

Q: Is Kynthai a substitute for my doctor?
A: No. Kynthai's AI answers are informational only. Always consult a licensed medical professional for diagnosis and treatment.

Q: Which US states are supported?
A: Kynthai is available nationwide. Lab test availability varies by location.

Q: Can I pay with cards and digital wallets?
A: Yes. All major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and ACH are accepted via Stripe.

Q: Is my health data safe?
A: Yes. Health data is encrypted at rest and in transit under HIPAA-aligned practices. You can export or delete your data anytime.

Q: Does it work for elderly family members?
A: Yes. The caretaker portal lets family members monitor elders' medication adherence, receive missed-dose alerts, and manage health records on their behalf. Large-text mode and simple UI options available.
